programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of employees' jobs. Forensic investigators must determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Curve
programme.desc: It was supposed to be a routine motorcade for the Queen of England. But on the way to Yosemite National Park, a car carrying three Secret Service agents collided with a car driven by a deputy from the local sheriff's office.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Visibility Zero
programme.desc: In 1993, the Amtrak Railroad experienced the deadliest train crash in United States history when the Sunset Limited derailed while crossing Alabama's Big Bayou Canot bridge. 47 passengers and crew were killed; scores more were injured.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flashover
programme.desc: A fire erupts in Kings Cross Station in London, killing 31 people and injuring dozens more. Investigators pinpoint the cause of the fire, but it takes state-of-the-art technology and fluid dynamics experts to explain why it became a deadly inferno.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hack Attack
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of jobs. Forensic investigators had to determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error, or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Road Rage
programme.desc: Police investigate a discarded sleeping bag containing bloody sneakers and a purse, which eventually leads to the body of a young woman. A mark found on the victim's body enables police to track the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hunter or Hunted
programme.desc: A woman is killed while walking her dogs in the woods. Since she has no enemies and her husband has an alibi, police assume it's a hunting accident — until they find a strange letter, allegedly written by the woman before her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In Harm's Way
programme.desc: An Alaskan police officer finds a woman's body while on routine patrol of a public park. During the autopsy, the medical examiner preserves the portion of her rib cage which sustained the fatal wound.

programme.title: Forensic Files: No Corpus Delicti
programme.desc: A woman disappears without a trace. Even though foul play is suspected, the leads don't pan out and the trail turns cold. Twenty years would pass before police are able to link a clump of hair discovered in an isolated area with the missing woman.

programme.title: Forensic Files: News at 11
programme.desc: When a talented television news anchor is shot to death outside her home, it appears to be a crime of passion perpetrated by an obsessed fan.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Burning Desire
programme.desc: Investigators sift through the ashes of a fire which killed a 40-year-old woman. The fire appears to have been started by an unattended cigarette. On closer look, forensic scientists discover the cause was far more complicated.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Blood
programme.desc: The forces of nature can reduce a body to bones in a matter of weeks. Using a unique combination of art and science, forensic anthropologists give victims a face long after they have been forgotten.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Living In Terror
programme.desc: Terrorism: Thanks to new technology and, perhaps, the approaching millennium, terrorism is a growing international threat. The Oklahoma City explosion and the bombing of the World Trade Center are just two of the incidents of this growing problem.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Trust
programme.desc: Poison is the subtlest form of death, and investigators must see through unusual circumstances to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Predators and Parasites
programme.desc: For the forensic entomologist, the insects that nest in dead bodies are like tiny witnesses to a crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Face Of Tragedy
programme.desc: Forensic Sculpting: Forensic sculptors retrieve people from oblivion. Using clay and an intricate knowledge of anatomy, forensic arts place a face on an unidentified skull, recreating the victim's likeness, which often leads to his name.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: A Prayer for the Dying
programme.desc: A mother of two is found dead in the most expensive part of Colorado Springs, leaving Lt. Joe Kenda stumped—until he looks into her personal life.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Where is Claudia Jane
programme.desc: 15-year old CJ Bates is reported missing, and Kenda must investigate the mysterious circumstances behind the disappearance of the teenager.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: New Year's Evil
programme.desc: It’s New Year’s Eve weekend, and in the midst of the revelry Miguel Mendez is beaten to death outside a convenience store. Lt. Joe Kenda faces a challenging investigation.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Blood From A Stone
programme.desc: A bystander receives a deadly head injury during a roadside altercation, but the stakes are raised when his body disappears from the scene. When a toddler is kidnapped for ransom Kenda joins forces with an undercover team in a desperate race against time.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Primal Instinct
programme.desc: When a drunken dispute at a biker bar turns deadly, Kenda must launch a manhunt for a pair of suspects who fled with a small boy in tow.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Loose Cannon
programme.desc: In the dead of night, a shooter on a rampage rips through a home, leaving a grandmother disfigured, her 24-year-old daughter dead, and a two year-old child clinging to life.

programme.title: On the Case: Taken

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Dead On Target

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Eye of the Beholder

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Aussie Ace

programme.title: COPS: Mom Still Loves You
programme.desc: Officers track down a suspect who eluded them earlier, a suspicious vehicle takes off at the sight of police, and a man gets busted for possession in front of his mom.

programme.title: COPS: The Young and the Reckless
programme.desc: Police catch up to a man with warrants and a history of resisting arrest, a fidgety driver arouses suspicion, and a minor with beers in his pants has to answer to his mom.

programme.title: COPS: Too Many Cooks
programme.desc: A fleeing driver becomes cooperative once he reaches his destination, a woman gets feisty with police, and police respond to a domestic dispute involving a frying pan.

programme.title: COPS: Second Time Around
programme.desc: Deputies are led on a chase by a driver they pursued just weeks earlier, and a man caught with drugs tries to pin the blame on his girlfriend.

programme.title: COPS: Party in a Box
programme.desc: Officers review dashcam footage after a suspect claims force was used against him unjustly, and a weed enthusiast drops some knowledge on police about the founding fathers.

programme.title: COPS: Two in the Bush
programme.desc: A woman leads police on a dangerous chase, a driver is remorseful for the damage he's caused, and a man's denial of solicitation is undermined by his open fly.

programme.title: COPS: Undeniably Fishy
programme.desc: A man loses his friend and finds trouble, officers stop a vehicle they believe was involved in a shooting, and a suspicious vehicle leads to a suspicious story.

programme.title: COPS: Nothing to See Here
programme.desc: A man's mole gives him away when he tries to fool police with a fake name, a drunken man shows officers he has nothing to hide, and a reckless driver imperils a neighborhood.

programme.title: COPS: Bible Buddies
programme.desc: Numerous patrol cars give chase to a man on a dirt bike refusing to yield, and an alleged armed robber is upfront about his reasons for running from police when approached.

programme.title: COPS: Shaking Like a Paint Mixer
programme.desc: A man blames the weed found in his car on his absent nephew, a suspect in custody starts to convulse, and police respond to a call about an armed man tripping on bath salts.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Victims of a Sadist - Cyril Koskinas Case
programme.desc: On July 19th 2004, the naked and tied up body of a woman is recovered in the Ourcq canal in Fresnes-sur-Marne. The victim is impossible to identify.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Triple Murders in Vise
programme.desc: On May 17th 2005, a body is discovered in a forest of Sucy-en-Brie; Christophe Belle, 40 years old, a renowned pastry cook.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Stabed In Her Bed: The Maureen Jaquier Case
programme.desc: On February 27, 2015, in Toulouse, the parents of 19-year-old Maureen Jacquier discover their daughter stabbed several times in her bed.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Evelyne Boucher Case
programme.desc: On December 9th 1987, the naked body of the young Evelyne Boucher is found near Avignon. An unprecedented investigation begins making headlines.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Corpse In The Cemetery: The Frederic Butanowicz Case
programme.desc: On November 9, 2011, the body of a man was found near the Courcelles-le-Comte cemetery (Pas-de-Calais).

programme.title: I huvudet på en gärningsman: Avsnitt 208
programme.desc: I juli 2008 skriver den då 25-årige Varg Nielsen i sin dagbok: “snart ett mord. vet vem, när, hur”. Två dagar senare träffar han en 23 årig småbarnsmamma och mördar henne med 40 knivhugg.

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 604
programme.desc: En 33-årig man hittas ihjälskjuten nära Sundsvall. Det visar sig vara en man som har skaffat sig många fiender och polisen listar i början av utredningen ett femtiotal personer med möjliga motiv.

programme.title: I huvudet på en gärningsman: Avsnitt 204
programme.desc: En kvinna ringer till SOS om att hennes sambo plötsligt blivit sjuk, varpå han körs akut till sjukhus. Det kommer visa sig att hon försökt giftmörda sin sambo - och det är inte heller första gången.

programme.title: Svenska fall
programme.desc: En försommardag 2017 anmäler en mamma att hennes dotter Tova är försvunnen. En stor polisinsats inleds, och efter någon dag hittar man Tovas kropp, fastsurrad i en skottkärra som sänkts i en sjö.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Avsnitt 305
programme.desc: Den 19 december 1994 klev Bjørn Thore Langemyhr på ett tåg från Tønsberg till Oslo. Det är det sista familjen ser av honom. När han inte dyker upp hemma på julafton slår familjen larm.

programme.title: Efterlyst
programme.desc: Den brutala misshandel som inträffade utanför Hovet efter matchen mellan AIK och Karlskoga i april tas upp. Efterlyst skildrar även de falska, AI-genererade annonserna som dykt upp på sociala medier.

programme.title: Efterlyst
programme.desc: Efterlyst tar upp den våg av inbrott på skolor som har ägt rum sedan i våras, där värdet på stölderna är över en miljon kronor. Vi visar också rånet mot Guldfynds butik på Södermalm den 7 juli.

programme.title: Efterlyst
programme.desc: Efterlyst är i Jönköping där 43-årige Simon hittades mördad i ett skogsområde i januari 2024. Vi får se övervakningsbilder på medlemmar i ligan som misstänks för minst 21 stölder från byggbutiker.

programme.title: Efterlyst
programme.desc: Vi får se en övervakningsfilm på den brutala attack som drabbade en man i 40-årsåldern i Uppsala den 17 augusti. Efterlyst tar upp inbrotten i jaktbutiker som ägt rum i Grums respektive Nyköping.

programme.title: Efterlyst
programme.desc: Polisen hoppas på avgörande tips kring vilka som misshandlade 58-årige Leif i Uppsala. Vi får även se övervakningsfilmer på sminktjuvar på ICA Maxi i Stenhagen och båtstölder i Stockholms skärgård.

programme.title: Efterlyst
programme.desc: Polisen söker fler vittnesmål och iakttagelser från natten där 36-årige Anton hittades mördad i Karlstad. Efterlyst tar upp fallet med mannen som rånade Guldfynds butik på Kungsgatan den 4 oktober.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna Räddar en Skoldag / Valparna Tänder Ljuset
programme.desc: Alex tappar bort sin ryggsäck första dagen i skolan! Nu behöver han hjälp från Ryder och Paw Patrol för att hitta väskan. // Chase fyller år och valparna planerar en överraskningsfest när strömmen går. Ska Paw Patrol lyckas rädda födelsedagskalaset?

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpar räddar bukten / Valpar räddar en Rospigg
programme.desc: Efter att en båt läckt ut olja måste Ryder och valparna städa upp Äventyrsbukten och rädda alla djuren. // När Äventyrsbuktens berömda staty hamnar på buktens botten måste Ryder och valparna komma på ett smart sätt att få upp den igen!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna och det Stora Loppet / Valparna och tårttävlingen
programme.desc: Valparna ska tävla om vem som är snabbast i Äventyrsbuktens stadslopp. Plötsligt dyker Alex oväntat upp på sin trehjuling. // Herr Porter ska delta i en tårttävling. För att kunna göra den största och smarrigaste tårtan behöver han Paw Patrols hjälp.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna räddar en fladdermus / Valparna räddar en tand
programme.desc: En fladdermusunge har tagit sig tupplur i klocktornet, vilket innebär att borgmästaren inte kan ringa i klockan! // Alex är rädd för tandläkaren, så Chase och resten av valparna hjälps åt för att visa Alex att man kan övervinna sina rädslor.

programme.desc: Marshall får en ny bästis när en gässling fattar tycke för honom men Ryder och Paw Patrol måste få den att flyga med sin flock. // Borgmästare Rospigg flyger av misstag upp med en luftballong och för Ryder och valparna blir det en dramatisk räddning.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna räddar julen
programme.desc: När tomtens släde kraschar och renarna rymmer, måste Ryder och Paw Patrol hjälpa till att dela ut de sista julklapparna och rädda julen!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valp Valp Boogie / Valparna visar vägen
programme.desc: Paw Patrol måste snabbt komma på ett sätt att laga den trasiga järnvägen innan nästa tåg kommer! // Ryder och Paw Patrol måste skynda sig och laga den trasiga fyren.
